_comment: The App Store 'text boxes' the release automation fills. Edit whatsNew every release. reviewInfo is written only when you pass --review-info to asc-prepare-version. The demo account PASSWORD is NEVER stored here — it is read from the ASC_DEMO_PASSWORD env var at run time. Everything in this file is non-secret and safe to commit.
whatsNew: Premium recipes are here — unlock a creator's full recipe: video, ingredients & steps. Share any recipe's video, with sound, straight to your Instagram Story. Pull down to refresh anywhere — For You, Following, profiles, and Saved — now with a Sizzle flame and a satisfying tap of haptics. Plus a smarter For You feed and faster, smoother video playback.

reviewInfo.notes:
HOW TO FIND THE IN-APP PURCHASES (addressing the previous 2.1(b) review):
Premium recipes are sold per-recipe by individual creators, so the purchase appears on the recipe itself rather than in a separate store screen. In build 34 they are now shown directly in the main feed.
1. Sign in with the demo account below (email tab).
2. On the Home tab (main video feed), scroll. Premium recipes appear as locked cards showing a lock icon, "Premium recipe", and an "Unlock · $5.99" button.
3. Tap "Unlock · $5.99" — the recipe opens with the paywall.
4. Tap "Unlock · $5.99" on the recipe. Apple's standard purchase sheet appears and the video, ingredients and steps unlock on completion.
Alternate path: Discover tab → search "Branden" → open @Branden → open the post "Hi Sizzle Peeps" ($5.99, lock badge) → Unlock.
The four consumables (premium_unlock_599/999/1499/1999) are the four price points a creator may choose. They are not restricted by storefront, region, or device, and work on iPhone and iPad. The Paid Applications Agreement is active.

Demo account: review@getsizzle.app (password provided in the App Review Information password field). Sign in with the email tab. The account follows 3 cooks, so both the Following and For You feeds are populated. It has no posts of its own; use the + tab to record or upload to see the creation flow.

User-generated content (Guideline 1.2): Sizzle has all four required mechanisms — (1) automated text + image moderation screens every submission before it can appear; (2) one-tap reporting via the ... menu on any post/comment/profile, five categories, into an internal moderation queue; (3) block/mute on any profile (mutual, total); (4) a published contact point at https://getsizzle.app/contact, also reachable in Settings. We act on reported content within 24 hours, a commitment published in our Terms and shown to every reporter.

Monetization (Guideline 3.1.1): Premium recipe unlocks are sold through Apple In-App Purchase. On a premium recipe a viewer taps 'Unlock · $X.XX' and completes Apple's standard purchase sheet; the four consumable products ($5.99 / $9.99 / $14.99 / $19.99) are submitted with this build, and every purchase is verified server-side before access is granted. Tips and creator subscriptions are NOT sold in the app — they remain on our website only, with no in-app price, link, or call-to-action. Creator-side earnings and payout setup are business onboarding (not a purchase), the same pattern TikTok/Instagram/YouTube ship; the demo account cannot reach payout setup (server-enforced: it requires 1,000 followers and 100,000 total video views).

To review the in-app purchase: sign in as the demo account, use Search to open the creator 'Branden' and their premium recipe 'Hi Sizzle Peeps', then tap 'Unlock · $5.99' — Apple's purchase sheet appears and the recipe's video, ingredients, and steps unlock on completion.
